sentences.text:
Shri Ashok Lalwani - Senior Advocate with Shri Yash R
 Advocate for the petitioners.

Order 
The present petition has been filed by the petitioners for modification of the order dated 06.06.2016 passed in M.A. No.2908/2012, whereby this Court in paragraph - 10 though has enhanced the amount of compensation under the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 to the tune of Rs.3,78,000/-, but has refused to grant the same for the reasons of having not paid the proper court fees and lack of valuation.

2. It has been submitted by the learned Senior Advocate that such observation in paragraph-10 is error apparent on the face of record because under the Act, 1988 as per Section 168, the claimants are entitled for the compensation, which is just and proper.

Once the Court has held that the claimants are entitled for Rs.3,78,000/- as just and proper compensation, then the claimants cannot be deprived of such compensation on account of less valuation or non-payment of court fees.

Learned Senior Advocate has placed NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:37165 2 RP-450-2016 on record the order dated 21.03.2018 passed in M.A. No.2666/2013, wherein in the similar situation, facts and circumstances, the amount was enhanced but the court fees was paid for lesser amount.
The Court has observed and directed that the amount so enhanced by Court shall be payable only after the payment of court fees that too within one month.
It is submitted that court fees of valuation of Rs.20,000/- paid in appeal may be adjusted.

3. The case of the petitioner is found to be similar and in the considered opinion of this Court,
claimants cannot be deprived with just and proper compensation.

Therefore, applying the same principles, the order dated 06.06.2016 passed in M.A. No.2908/2012 is modified to the the extent that in case, the appellants/claimants deposits the court fees on enhanced amount of Rs.1,37,000/-
and interest, within one month from the date of this order, they are entitled to be paid the enhanced amount.
The Court fees already deposited be adjusted accordingly.
This order shall be read Jagannath vs Ramswaroop on 7 August, 2025
